questions.question: append vs extend?
questions.answer: append ek single item add karta hai; extend iterable ke items ko alag-alag add karta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: remove vs pop?
questions.answer: remove value ke first matching item ko hataata hai. pop index se item hataata hai aur removed value return karta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: sort vs sorted?
questions.answer: sort list ko in-place modify karta hai aur None return karta hai. sorted nayi sorted list deta hai aur any iterable par chal sakta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: sort(key=...) ka use?
questions.answer: Custom sorting criterion define karne ke liye, jaise strings ko length ya tuples ko score ke basis par.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: List ko stack ke roop me kaise use karte hain?
questions.answer: append() push aur pop() pop. Isse LIFO behaviour milta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: Order-safe duplicate removal?
questions.answer: dict.fromkeys(items) se insertion order preserve karte hue duplicates remove kar sakte hain.
